data.gender_notes: Hayet is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hayyaa', meaning 'to live'. This name represents the essence of life itself, emphasizing the importance and value of existence in Islamic teachings. The name Hayet carries the meaning “Life, Existence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hayet usually hope their child will grow to embody life, existence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the continuity of life and the soul's journey towards spiritual growth in Islam.
data.etymology: Hayet belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life, Existence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hayet total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
